artworks.title: Three Drums, One Heartbeat
artworks.desc: Three drummers in orange, red, and blue laugh as they play together against a wall of scraped paint and splashes of color. Expressive painted wall art celebrating rhythm, joy, and music as community.

artworks.title: Vision Keeper
artworks.desc: A sunburst eye glows above her golden halo while ankh earrings hang beneath. Bold splatter-style wall art about vision, intuition, and seeing what others miss.

artworks.title: Library of the Mind
artworks.desc: Open books and glowing connected nodes rise from her hair like a network of ideas. Bold gold-and-black splatter art about knowledge, learning, and a mind that never stops building.

artworks.title: The Creator's Crown
artworks.desc: A camera, light bulb, crown, paintbrushes, fountain pen, vinyl record, and piano keys burst from her hair like a crown made of tools. Bold splatter-style wall art that celebrates every kind of creator.

artworks.title: Five Faces, One Sun
artworks.desc: Five faces turn upward beneath a single golden halo, sunglasses and headwraps catching the same light. Bold splatter-style wall art about community, unity, and looking in the same direction together.

artworks.title: Crown of Rays
artworks.desc: A woman in white-framed sunglasses tilts her face toward the light as bars of black, red, and blue radiate from a golden sun above her, ankh earrings swinging below. Bold splatter-style wall art about confidence and rising.

artworks.title: Built From The Fire
artworks.desc: An elder with a silver beard looks upward, one hand over his heart, with open books and a golden city rising behind him from a field of ember-red shards. Cubist-style wall art about wisdom forged through hardship, faith, and the stories that survive the fire.

artworks.title: The Language Between Us
artworks.desc: Generations reach toward a single glowing seed beneath the branches of an ancient tree, their faces and hands woven into one pattern. Cubist-style wall art about heritage, family, and the language we pass between us.

artworks.title: She Carries Tomorrow
artworks.desc: A mother carries her sleeping child through a quilted landscape of homes, gardens, and city towers while a golden sun rises behind her. Cubist-style wall art about legacy, hope, and the future one family holds in its arms.

artworks.title: Passing the Brush
artworks.desc: An elder places a paintbrush in a young hand while generations of faces look on in fractured light. Cubist art about legacy, mentorship, and the gift of passing the craft forward.

artworks.title: Quiet Embrace on the City Stoop
artworks.desc: A couple holds each other on a city stoop beside a pot of white blossoms, wrapped in warm reds and golds. A cubist love story told in a single, tender moment.

artworks.title: Rising Through Fractured Light
artworks.desc: A figure reaches toward a sunburst breaking through storm clouds, new growth sprouting from the roots below. Cubist art about resilience, hope, and rising after the hardest seasons.

artworks.title: Balanced Scales
artworks.desc: A woman holds the scales of justice before marble columns while a diverse crowd looks up toward her. Cubist wall art on fairness, accountability, and the long work of equal justice.

artworks.title: From Sketches to Storefront
artworks.desc: A woman in a vibrant headwrap turns a pencil sketch into a shop with an awning, a rising arrow, and fabric swatches at her side. A cubist tribute to Black entrepreneurship and the journey from idea to open door.

artworks.title: The Studio of Unfolding Ideas
artworks.desc: An artist at the palette while a dove, a violin, and a classical bust drift out of the canvas in fractured light. Cubist art for creators, dreamers, and anyone building something from nothing.

artworks.title: Radiant Stillness
artworks.desc: A woman in prayer, her folded hands lit by rays of golden light breaking through angular shadow. A cubist meditation on faith, peace, and the quiet strength of stillness.

artworks.title: Open Book, Endless Possibility
artworks.desc: A mother and three children lean into a glowing open book as light bursts from its pages over the city skyline. Cubist wall art about learning, imagination, and the doors that reading opens.

artworks.title: Generations Around the Table
artworks.desc: Elders, parents, and children share fruit and conversation in fractured planes of gold, blue, and crimson. A cubist portrait of family, memory, and the meal that holds a lineage together.

artworks.title: One Garden, Many Hands
artworks.desc: Neighbors of every age kneel in the soil together, tending tomatoes and greens beneath a rising sun. A cubist celebration of community, harvest, and the work we do side by side.

artworks.title: Kente Geometry
artworks.desc: Interlocking gold, terracotta and green bands — heritage abstracted to pure rhythm.

artworks.title: Molten Lineage
artworks.desc: Many bronze streams converging into one broad river of light — many bloodlines, one current.

artworks.title: Sankofa Spiral
artworks.desc: A single luminous spiral turning back on itself — return to the past to move forward.

artworks.title: Diaspora Bloom
artworks.desc: Scattered elements flowering into one radiant golden bloom — dispersed, then unified.

artworks.title: The Crown Frequency
artworks.desc: A crown of light pulsing outward on black. Royalty rendered as pure energy.

artworks.title: Cool, Personified
artworks.desc: Indigo and gold moving like a jazz solo caught mid-phrase — effortless, undeniable cool.

artworks.title: Ancestral Current
artworks.desc: Rivers of molten gold winding through charcoal — lineage in motion, generation to generation.

artworks.title: Resilient Strata
artworks.desc: Pressed geological bands, cracked but holding. Tough times never last, but tough people do.

artworks.title: Undeniable
artworks.desc: A crown bursting into confident strokes of gold and amber — swagger rendered as pure form.

artworks.title: Power in the Tongue
artworks.desc: Gold-and-copper ripples spiraling from the dark — the spoken word made into living, resonant energy.

artworks.title: Ancestral Rhythm V
artworks.desc: Radiant color and sculptural form close the Ancestral Rhythm series with strength and grace. A collector-ready work that transforms the wall into a celebration of identity and legacy.

artworks.title: Ancestral Rhythm IV
artworks.desc: A commanding contemporary portrait where pattern, poise, and cultural memory become one visual language. Made to give a room confidence, depth, and unmistakable character.

artworks.title: Ancestral Rhythm III
artworks.desc: Layered color and expressive geometry carry the pulse of memory forward. A soulful statement piece celebrating Black beauty as inheritance, movement, and living art.

artworks.title: Ivory & Bronze
artworks.desc: Ivory light and burnished bronze meet in a portrait of quiet authority. Refined, luminous, and timeless, this piece brings warmth and elevated presence to contemporary interiors.

artworks.title: Ancestral Rhythm II
artworks.desc: Color, geometry, and expression move together in this radiant celebration of Black identity. A bold statement piece that brings warmth, rhythm, and unmistakable presence to any room.

artworks.title: Ancestral Rhythm I
artworks.desc: A soulful contemporary portrait honoring beauty, softness, and inherited strength. Designed to give a room emotional depth while keeping the energy elegant and uplifting.

artworks.title: Ebony Architecture
artworks.desc: Black beauty becomes living architecture through sculptural shadows and confident lines. Sophisticated and commanding, this piece was made for spaces that deserve strength, elegance, and presence.

artworks.title: Teal Oxidation
artworks.desc: Teal, bronze, and weathered patina turn transformation into beauty. This richly textured portrait adds depth, character, and a sense of timeless resilience to modern interiors.

artworks.title: Terracotta Strata
artworks.desc: Warm earth tones and layered geometry reveal a portrait shaped by memory and endurance. A grounded, luxurious work that brings ancestral energy and quiet power into the room.

artworks.title: Fractured Copper Crown
artworks.desc: Copper, shadow, and fractured geometry form a crown that transformation could not break. A striking symbol of resilience, royalty, and the power to rebuild without losing who you are.

artworks.title: The Scholar King
artworks.desc: Wisdom wears the crown in this commanding portrait of knowledge, leadership, and cultural inheritance. A powerful centerpiece for offices, libraries, studios, and homes built around ambition and legacy.

artworks.title: Where the Tide Remembers Us
artworks.desc: Two souls meet at the edge of eternity in a luminous celebration of Black love, peace, and devotion. Ocean blues and warm golds make this an unforgettable focal point for a bedroom, living room, or retreat.

artworks.title: The Crown Within
artworks.desc: A regal vision of power that does not wait for permission or recognition. Crown, city, and cultivated beauty merge into one unforgettable declaration: everything needed to rise was already within.

artworks.title: We Are the Continuation
artworks.desc: Generations rise together beneath the ancestral sun in one unbroken portrait of heritage. This powerful work honors family, protection, wisdom, and the legacy we carry forward.

artworks.title: Stillness Knows My Name
artworks.desc: Beneath a crescent moon, quiet water and blooming lotus flowers create a sanctuary of deep blues, greens, and gold. A serene statement piece for spaces devoted to peace, reflection, and restoration.

artworks.title: Love Is the Peacemaker
artworks.desc: An embrace, open hands, doves, and olive branches present love as an active force. Tender yet powerful, this piece brings warmth, hope, and the possibility of peace into any space.

artworks.title: Where the Rhythm Lives
artworks.desc: Voice, brass, keys, and percussion become one vibrant architecture of sound. An electric celebration of Black music as memory, language, survival, and joy—perfect for a room that should feel alive.

artworks.title: When Time Stood Still
artworks.desc: Against a luminous cityscape of gold and deep indigo, two souls find the rare luxury of being fully present. Romantic, sophisticated, and emotionally rich, this piece turns any room into a sanctuary.

artworks.title: Harlem Dusk
artworks.desc: Harlem glows at the edge of evening in a composition alive with culture, confidence, and city rhythm. A stylish statement piece that brings warmth, history, and metropolitan soul to the wall.

artworks.title: Gold Skyline
artworks.desc: A radiant skyline rises in gold with the energy of ambition made visible. Bold, polished, and aspirational, this work brings a sense of movement and possibility to offices and contemporary living spaces.

artworks.title: The Crown & The Pen
artworks.desc: The crown rests on the instrument that built the empire. A bold tribute to writers, visionaries, and self-made creators who turn ideas into legacy—made for the room where the next chapter begins.
